Name: Elon, Judge of Israel
Summary: Elon, a Zebulonite, judged Israel ten years and was buried in Aijalon in Zebulun. He is distinct from Elon, son of Zebulun, in Genesis.
KeyStory: After Ibzan, Elon the Zebulonite judged Israel ten years, and died and was buried in Aijalon in the country of Zebulun.
LifeLesson: Ten quiet years, one burial place — the whole record.
